This is a whole new season of EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile! The 27 Season Update puts The World’s Game right in your hands! Shift the focus back to your club with game-changing tactical freedom, an intense squad-building challenge mode, and revolutionary PlayStyles designed to elevate your matchday experience. 
 
 NEW 27 FEATURES
 
GAME PLANS & DYNAMIC TACTICS
 Take full control of your team's tactical identity with the new Game Plan system.
 -In-Match Switching: Adapt on the fly by changing formations and mentalities dynamically mid-match.
 -5 Mentality Tiers: Fine-tune your strategy across Ultra Defensive, Defensive, Balanced, Attacking, and Ultra Attacking.
 -Custom Presets: Create and save up to 4 distinct Game Plans to switch between instantly during matches. 
 
GAUNTLET MODE
 Take on the FC Mobile Gauntlet through a series of challenging rounds that test your squad depth and tactical skills.
 - Each round features unique Match Objectives, Traits, and House Rules.
 - House Rules such as Hot Zone, Position Hero, and No Rules can also change how each match plays.
 - Strategic Squad Management: Player Items have limited appearances per run, forcing you to rotate your roster.
 -Progress through nodes, earn Stars, and unlock milestone Rewards. 
 
GAMEPLAY UPDATES
 Two new PlayStyles bring player abilities to life:
 - Incisive Through Pass: Thread through-balls with improved target selection and greater lead distance.
 - Dead Ball: Bend free kicks with increased curl, pace, dip, and precision.
 
AUDIO & VISUALS
 - Localized Matchday Energy: Feel the passion of the crowd with updated, immersive localized commentary in Mexican Spanish, Indonesian, and Thai. 
 - Signature Celebrations: Express your victories in style with brand-new iconic goal celebrations, including "Predator", "Flex", "Fist Pump", "Rockstar", and "Tuxedo"! 
 - Enjoy an overall visual refresh of the game in this new season update. 

Play The World’s Game, anywhere.

Approximately 3.5 GB of free storage space is required to download and install eFootball™.

An internet connection is required to play eFootball™. We also strongly recommend playing with a stable connection to ensure you get the most out of the game.

The new 26/27 season has officially kicked off, and your favorite football club needs a manager. Online Soccer Manager is a free-to-play football manager game featuring every real league, club, and player from around the world — the most authentic soccer manager simulator you can play on mobile.

Sign your contract and start your football manager career at a club from the Premier League, Serie A, La Liga, or any other league on the planet. Build your dream team at a club like Real Madrid, FC Barcelona, or Liverpool FC — or take an underdog and turn it into a champion.

Once you're in charge, every decision is yours. Build your ideal formation and line-up, then master a deep tactics and strategy system to prepare for every matchday. Use the sophisticated transfer market to buy and sell players, and rely on the scouting system to find the next big star or a proven veteran anywhere in the world.

Train your squad to sharpen their skills over the season, and play unlimited friendly matches whenever you want to test new tactics without any risk. Expand and upgrade your stadium to bring in more revenue and unlock better facilities for your club.

Every match comes to life with dynamic simulation visuals, so you can watch your tactics play out in real time. Chase your ambitions further by trying to complete the World Map, proving your management skills across the globe. Your club's board is counting on you to deliver results and lead your team toward the title this season.

This isn't just a solo career mode — it's multiplayer at its core. Join a league with your friends, compete for the top spot, and prove who's the better manager. Or test yourself against real managers from all over the world, in a community of over 50 million players. OSM is available in 30 languages, so wherever you're playing from, the game speaks yours.

The 26/27 season is live right now. Download Online Soccer Manager and start building your legacy today.

This game includes optional in-app purchases, including items with randomized rewards. See our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for details.

Experience the next generation of football gaming right on your mobile device! UFL is the soccer simulation that puts your talent to the ultimate test. It's time to build your legacy from the ground up and challenge players globally in a fair, engaging, and competitive environment.

Build your football club: start your journey, assemble your dream top eleven squad, and implement a strategy that rewards pure football games knowledge. UFL is designed for fresh, skill-rewarding gameplay where the pro sport manager and player win. Experience the most authentic mobile gameplay.

ENTER THE UFL LEGACY: Play with the confidence of a global title.
Take total control of your club's destiny. Recruit players from a massive database, develop unique training programs, and craft complex formations. Every decision you make impacts your team's chemistry and performance in the global league.

FEATURES:
Free-to-Play, skill-based gameplay. Your tactics and reflexes are the only path to the top, ensuring that victory depends on your performance on the pitch rather than your wallet.

Regular updates shaped by the community and football updates. Join a game that evolves with you.

Play soccer. Take the game with you wherever you go. Enjoy the freedom to master your skills and play matches even without an internet connection, making it perfect for gaming anytime, anywhere.

Every pass, every tackle, and every goal is a testament to your personal mastery. Forget the noise and focus on the grass beneath your feet. Here, your journey from a local football club to a global powerhouse is fueled by nothing but your passion and your performance. The stadium is waiting, the crowd is hushed, and the next legendary moment is yours to create.

UFL brings console-quality simulation to your phone, offering a friendly environment where superior techniques are always rewarded. Become a part of the revolution! Build your dream club, compete with the world's best, and experience a new era of mobile soccer. Play UFL and prove your skill!

results.releaseNotes:
FIFA Heroes enters a new era with our biggest ever update!

KUNG FU PANDA SEASON PASS
Travel back to ancient China with Po, Tigress, Zhen, Grand Master Oogway, and Tai Lung with the Kung Fu Panda Season Pass featuring exclusive avatars, titles, and emojis.
Po also arrives with the new Shadowstep ability! Disappear in a puff of smoke and run up the pitch invisible to opponents or rush up behind to surprise them.

NEW FEATURES
Knockout Rush arrives! To celebrate the start of the regular football season, players can now play through this brand new game mode. Every match gets you one step closer to the final, collecting Tokens as you do. Trade your Tokens in for exclusive rewards including a pitch and cosmetic items!
The Manager’s Office opens! Send players on Sponsorship assignments to earn valuable Coins and Gems, Scout for players to join your team, or send existing squadmates on Training so they can upgrade to a higher level
Keep track of the players you’ve earned and those remaining in the new Collection. Acquire all players from a specific team to unlock their unique bonus reward
Connect your FIFA Heroes account to your FIFA ID to earn 200 Gems! Complete Challenges on fifa.com/rewards to earn FIFA Points that are then exchangeable for both digital and physical items. Connecting your FIFA ID also enables Cloud Saves - meaning players can move freely from one device to another with all their data saved
Keep informed with information about the game, news from the world of FIFA, and more via the new Inbox, accessible from your (updated) Profile screen
Have a close match or lose due to a buzzer-beating goal? Hit the new REMATCH button to jump back in with the same opponent
Players will now be rewarded after every match with a Locker. Watch an advert to then play Bonus Shot for an additional reward!
New players will now receive a free Timed Locker after finishing the tutorial. This locker has a 24 hour countdown and guarantees an Epic player upon opening.

IMPROVEMENTS
Daily Login Rewards now extend all the way to 30 days with the final reward being the Barcelona pitch. Additionally, the screen has been given a nice makeover
Players will now no longer lose League Points in Wooden League for losing a match. As players climb through the Divisions, LP loss will increase until reaching Diamond League where every match has an equal LP loss/gain for losing or winning a match
The Locker received from watching an advert has now been upgraded to Epic quality
Challenges now refresh every 15 minutes

ADJUSTMENTS
The previous “Rookie Player” title has been renamed to “New Signing!”
The previous “Blitz Master” title has been renamed to “FIFA Hero”

FIFA Heroes is a new breed of fast-paced, arcade style, soccer mobile game where you can build a squad of soccer superstars and legends, FIFA World Cup™ mascots, surprise celebrities, mythical heroes and other beloved characters. Play it to dominate the leaderboard in real-time multiplayer matches. Gameplay consists of 5v5 street soccer games with unique power ups. The variety of characters, the unique looks you can create for them, the non-simulation fantasy-breaker gameplay, and the exciting game modes with casual controls all add up to a fresh new take on the future of soccer gaming.

FIFA OFFICIAL LICENSED GAME
FIFA Heroes lets you dominate the leaderboards in style with FIFA World Cup 2026™ soccer superstars and mascots! Maple™ the Moose, Zayu™ the Jaguar and Clutch™ the Bald Eagle, as well as many other FIFA World Cup mascots from the past, are playable characters in the game, all with their own unique skill moves and goal celebrations! 

ISHOWSPEED
Pure speed. Pure chaos. Pure entertainment. The human highlight reel is a playable character, here to unleash the fastest show in soccer and turn every match into a viral moment. Out-hype everyone by playing over-the-top power moves and scoring crazy goals with IShowSpeed, Central Cee, Marlon, J Balvin, Luva and the most exciting soccer players today, including Enzo Fernandez and Joao Pedro.

INNOVATIVE GAMEPLAY EXPERIENCE
A 5v5 multiplayer soccer gameplay experience like never before, FIFA Heroes breaks the fantasy of simulation games from the past, enabling you to build crazy squads where soccer legends team up with today’s soccer stars, celebrities, and all sorts of other characters to play for glory inside a volcano, or on a glacier, or many other mind-blowing soccer pitches. Each character has a crazy skill/power move and celebration—a soccer game unlike any other.

BUILD YOUR FANTASY SOCCER TEAM
Choose soccer stars from the FIFA World Cup™ national teams past and present, and pair them up with mascots, mythical characters and more. Mix-and-match to find your perfect pick at each position on the playing field, then level up your players to increase their skills and power. Make the squad uniquely yours, then show it off in blitz matches, while sharpening your skills with every match you play.

FAST-PACED FIFA STREET SOCCER
Take it to the streets! Your speed, skills and reflexes are as important as having the right characters in your squad. Experience heart-pounding, turbocharged moments of multiplayer gameplay that will test your reaction time on the way to leaderboard domination.

SEASON PASSES
New heroes step onto the field and enrich your gameplay. Play throughout the season pass for your chance to unlock new rewards, including heroes, new emojis, new avatars, and more. Dive back in to find out which unique characters could line up in your squad.

MAKE IT UNIQUE
Show off to your friends and other players from around the world with your choice of characters, pitch, gear and your collection of emotes. The combination possibilities are endless. Have fun with it!

PLAY FIFA HEROES ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
The most exciting soccer gaming experience in years is available at your fingertips, any time you feel like playing. There is always one more match waiting for you to dominate the competition.

Build your squad, master their skills, and dominate the competition in a brand-new way to play the world’s favorite sport.

results.description:
Play these thrilling soccer games and rise to become a soccer star on the field. 

Assemble your ultimate team, wear your kits with pride, and play with professional tactics to score goals and win all soccer matches. Whether you're playing in career mode or representing your national team, the experience of becoming a hero is within your reach. Live your dream of a champion and win the league with your strategic shots.

Unleash the power of your team and show the world which nation has the best soccer players. With your strategic shots, professional tactics and skills, you'll dominate the field and lead your dream team to victory in every match, season after season. So put on your soccer kits, kick the ball, and win the hearts of fans in stadiums around the world, all the way to the semi-finals and finals.
 
Get acquainted with controls with Basics, and put on your kits for tournaments and other soccer events.


GAME MODES

CAREER INCLUDES
- Next match - Play soccer matches, improve your league progress, and move up to the better league.
- Team management - Be a soccer manager and edit your players.
- Statistics - Follow your team's progress and statistics.
- Season objectives - Complete 4 objectives during each soccer season.

EVENTS INCLUDE
- Daily Challenges - A set of 5 challenges every day.
- Champions Cup - The best European teams meet every year to win the cup.
- Europa - Win the cup which is held every 4 years in Europe.
- Copa Del Sur - Compete with the best South American teams.
- Tournament - Triumph soccer matches of 32 national teams.


Train hard, come to the field, and triumph over all your opponents in every match to become a soccer legend. Score goal after goal with your precision passing, dribbling, and shooting skills. Master your penalties, free-kicks, and corner kicks with ease, while always staying alert to avoid getting caught offside. And if it comes down to a penalty shootout, respect the referee and trust your goalkeeper to make the crucial saves.

As a forward, midfielder, or defender, you will be a crucial part of your team's success on the field. So work together with your teammates and always be ready to make that crucial pass, tackle, or interception that can make you a soccer star. Or even score a hat trick or win the Golden Boot!

From the first whistle of the soccer season to the final match of the championship, this game has everything for you to become a true soccer legend. Whether you're playing in a league or tournament, dressing up in your ultimate team colors or just kicking the ball, it is a chance to lead your team to victory.

Work on your ball control, passing accuracy, and shooting precision, and get ready for all the tournaments. Whether you're playing in career mode, representing your national team, or leading your club to the championship, win every match. So step onto the field, and let your goals speak for themselves.
 
Play soccer games and lead your team to glory in prestigious league tournaments. Win every match, show your talents on the field, score goals, and earn the recognition of soccer fans and fellow players alike. Make a name in the competitive world of soccer. So grab your ball, hit the field, and become the soccer legend you were born to be!
